**Echo 1.2.3 — Custom Carrier String in Status Bar**

* Replaces carrier string in iOS 12 status bar with custom text or emoji
* Real-time update via Darwin notification (no respring needed)
* Full compatibility with iPhone 5s compact 320px status bar
* Settings bundle in Settings > Echo
* Strict Pure GNU Tar format (resolves corrupted filesystem tarfile error)

**Compatibility:** iPhone 5s (Apple A7 arm64), iOS 12.0 – 12.5.8.
**Architecture:** Rootful Sileo / Zebra / Cydia APT.
